clawhub_summary: The Tavily Search skill is a web search tool that uses the Tavily API as an alternative to Brave. It returns a small set of relevant results and can optionally include short answer summaries. The skill appears safe for general use, as it is internally consistent and follows best practices in all five safety categories.
clawhub_assessment: The Tavily Search skill is well-designed and safe for use. Before installing this skill, users should ensure that they have the required Tavily API key and have stored it securely in an environment variable or.env file. Users should also be aware that the skill keeps max-results small by default to reduce token/reading load and prefers returning URLs and snippets, fetching full pages only when needed. This skill is benign and suitable for general use.
clawhub_purpose_capability_desc: The name, description, and stated capabilities of the skill match its instructions and code. There are no undisclosed capabilities or mismatches between the declared purpose and the implementation.
clawhub_instruction_scope_desc: The runtime instructions of the skill are tightly scoped to the stated purpose and avoid reading unrelated system files, contacting unexpected external endpoints, or treating retrieved content as executable instructions.
clawhub_install_mechanism_desc: The skill does not download scripts from the internet, use pip/npm at runtime, or write files outside the workspace during installation. It uses only bundled code or clearly declared dependencies.
clawhub_credentials_desc: The skill handles API keys and authentication tokens securely, using secret_ref patterns and avoiding hardcoding, logging, or transmitting secrets in plaintext.
clawhub_persistence_privilege_desc: The skill does not modify agent settings, other skills, or system-wide configuration, and it does not request elevated privileges beyond what the task requires. It writes data only within its declared workspace.
